contract: EduAutis Sensory-Safe Inclusive Design Direction Contract (ui-design-contract.md). Target audience: autistic students (calm, predictable, large touch targets >= 64px, zero emoji) and teachers/educators (editorial split-canvas portal & clean data workspaces, WCAG AA/AAA).

accessibility.evidence: Verified with scripts/check-contrast.mjs passing WCAG AA (13.93:1 calm canvas) and AAA (21.00:1 high-contrast). Auth forms support physical keyboard input, visible 3px :focus-visible outline, aria-describedby error binding, aria-pressed password toggle, and >= 64px student keypad buttons.

responsive.evidence: Auth split-shell (.auth-shell) transitions from 42%/58% horizontal desktop grid (1440x900) to stacked single-column card with form-first ordering at <= 879px (390x844) and zero horizontal overflow.

loading.evidence: Auth views render static server-rendered Blade markup without layout shift; audio/game/quiz subviews use calm loading indicators.

empty.evidence: Empty material and quiz states display calm empty-state cards with return actions.

error.evidence: Auth error banners (.auth-alert) and field validation messages (.auth-error) display warm non-alarming amber feedback and inline recovery hints.

partial.reason: Authentication forms render complete self-contained cards without partial loading chunks.

success.evidence: Successful authentication redirects directly to /beranda (student) or /admin (teacher) verified by AuthTest (8/8 tests passing).

permission.evidence: Guest and role middlewares redirect authenticated/unauthorized roles safely to 403 or intended dashboard.

renderedEvidence.observation: Rendered auth.login-student shows form-first mobile ordering, Segmented Switcher tabs, Username field, 6-slot tactile PIN tray, and 12-key 64px keypad with zero emojis.

Rendered auth.role-select displays balanced 42%/58% editorial split shell with deep slate learning pillars pane and crisp horizontal role selection tiles ('Saya Siswa' and 'Saya Guru') with zero emojis.
Rendered auth.login-teacher displays deep pine architectural pane alongside elevated white login panel with segmented role tabs, password show/hide toggle, and emerald submit action.
